Module com.example.fortune_cookies_app
Package com.example.fortune_cookies_app.model

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.fortune_cookies_app.model.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents an Event with details such as event date, name, description, importance, and associated user ID.
